propositions: The concurrency overlay must be registered by adding it to the OVERLAY_IDS enum and wired to the overlay_union workflow step so the base reviewer can escalate to it.

Content-triggered detection must scan both added and removed diff lines for a committed list of 38 concurrency-related token literals (locks, threads, async primitives, channels, database/file locking), with a measured fire rate of 14% on historical commits.
Routing configuration must specify the concurrency overlay as advisory-posture, 0.95 block threshold, with blocking disabled, derived from RacerD production precedent.

The gate dispatch must add two lines to code-review.yaml (round_a and round_b batches) to conditionally invoke the code-review-concurrency prompt based on trigger output flags, following the existing per-overlay pattern.
Negative test controls must verify that noisy token families (async/await, bare fork, Promise.all, setInterval, select) do NOT fire the overlay, and context-only tokens are excluded.
